cabríos: plural of «cabrío»: goat ("macho cabrío": male goat)
cantadle: sing (to several people; old form) + «le» (to him/her)
cortados: plural of «cortado»: cut off, cut down
formases: plural of «formas»: plural of «forma»: form, shape
sacados: plural of «sacado»: brought out, taken out
solemnidades: plural of «solemnidad»: solemn feast, appointed feast
